cases.purpose: As real root with private passwd/group rows, cred drop ends with real/effective/saved uid and gid equal to the target, a group list of exactly the primary gid (or the /etc/group memberships plus the primary, deduplicated, with --keep-supplementary), cred status reports the same list in getgroups order, and a failure injected at setgroups, setresgid or setresuid by a kernel seccomp filter leaves the documented partial state with status 64 naming the failing call.
cases.oracle: Kernel-reported credentials of the dropping process (its own /proc/PID/status Uid/Gid/Groups), GNU id -G for the group-membership oracle (initgroups semantics), the documented order setgroups, setresgid, setresuid, and kernel errno injection by a seccomp filter (mig-w4-inject.py, SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO) installed before the candidate runs.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout: per scenario the exit status, the process's own Uid/Gid/Groups lines, the cred status line, a flag comparing the group list with GNU id -G, and for each injected failure whether the diagnostic names the failing call, the resulting state and whether it differs from the pre-call state.
cases.script:
P=$PWD
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers
cat > "$P/passwd.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
alice:x:3001:3001:Alice:/tmp/parity-case/home-alice:/bin/bash
bob:x:3002:3002:Bob:/tmp/parity-case/no-such-home:/bin/bash
X
cat > "$P/group.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:
alice:x:3001:alice
bob:x:3002:
staff:x:4000:alice
wheel:x:4001:alice,bob
ops:x:5000:
X
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/passwd.fx" /etc/passwd || echo "MOUNT-FAIL passwd"
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/group.fx" /etc/group || echo "MOUNT-FAIL group"
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 755 "$P/home-alice"
snap() { local l; set -f; while IFS= read -r l; do case $l in Uid:*|Gid:*|Groups:*|NoNewPrivs:*) echo $l;; esac; done < /proc/$BASHPID/status; set +f; }

oa=$(/usr/bin/id -G alice | /usr/bin/tr ' ' '\n' | /usr/bin/sort -n | /usr/bin/paste -sd,)
ob=$(/usr/bin/id -G bob | /usr/bin/tr ' ' '\n' | /usr/bin/sort -n | /usr/bin/paste -sd,)
base=$(cred status); echo "baseline: ${base%% groups=*}"
( cred drop alice; echo "A rc=$?"; snap; echo "A status: $(cred status)" )
( cred drop alice --keep-supplementary; echo "B rc=$?"; snap; st=$(cred status); echo "B status: $st"
  [[ ${st#*groups=} == "$oa" ]] && echo "B groups-match-id=yes" || echo "B groups-match-id=no[$oa]" )
( cred drop bob --keep-supplementary; echo "C rc=$?"; snap; st=$(cred status); echo "C status: $st"
  [[ ${st#*groups=} == "$ob" ]] && echo "C groups-match-id=yes" || echo "C groups-match-id=no[$ob]" )
cat > "$P/inner.sh" <<'X'
cred status > "$1.before"
cred drop alice 2> "$1.err"; rc=$?
err=$(< "$1.err")
echo "rc=$rc names=$([[ $err == *"drop alice: $2"* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
st=$(cred status); b=$(< "$1.before")
echo "ids: ${st%% groups=*}"
[[ ${st#*groups=} == "${b#*groups=}" ]] && echo "groups: unchanged" || echo "groups: ${st#*groups=}"
X
inj() { /usr/bin/python3 "$H/mig-w4-inject.py" "$1:1" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$P/inner.sh" "$P/$1" "$2" 2>&1 | while IFS= read -r l; do echo "$3 $l"; done; }
inj setresuid 'setresuid(3001): Operation not permitted' D1
inj setresgid 'setresgid(3001): Operation not permitted' D2
inj setgroups 'setgroups(1): Operation not permitted' D3
cases.stdout:
baseline: uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 egid=0
A rc=0
Uid: 3001 3001 3001 3001
Gid: 3001 3001 3001 3001
Groups: 3001
A status: uid=3001 gid=3001 euid=3001 egid=3001 groups=3001
B rc=0
Uid: 3001 3001 3001 3001
Gid: 3001 3001 3001 3001
Groups: 3001 4000 4001
B status: uid=3001 gid=3001 euid=3001 egid=3001 groups=3001,4000,4001
B groups-match-id=yes
C rc=0
Uid: 3002 3002 3002 3002
Gid: 3002 3002 3002 3002
Groups: 3002 4001
C status: uid=3002 gid=3002 euid=3002 egid=3002 groups=3002,4001
C groups-match-id=yes
D1 rc=64 names=yes
D1 ids: uid=0 gid=3001 euid=0 egid=3001
D1 groups: 3001
D2 rc=64 names=yes
D2 ids: uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 egid=0
D2 groups: 3001
D3 rc=64 names=yes
D3 ids: uid=0 gid=0 euid=0 egid=0
D3 groups: unchanged
